title: tmux Session: Start, Detach, Reattach
description: Seven lines show the tmux workflow: create a named session, launch a long agent task, detach with Ctrl-b d, close the laptop, then reattach from anywhere to find the agent still running.

steps.description: The sequence creates a session named 'agents', runs claude inside it, detaches with Ctrl-b then d, and later reattaches with tmux attach -t agents from a fresh SSH login.

steps.question: What does detaching do to the agent task?
steps.answer: the agent keeps running the whole time on the multiplexer's persistent server
